name: data.gov.sg APIs (real-time and datastore)
summary: Singapore government open data: real-time weather, traffic and environment feeds plus datastore search over published datasets, usable without a key at a low rate.
description: Two API families: v2 real-time endpoints on api-open.data.gov.sg (air temperature, rainfall, PM2.5, taxi availability, carpark availability and similar feeds) and a datastore_search endpoint that pages through any tabular dataset, for example HDB resale prices. Collection and dataset metadata APIs list what exists. Registering for an API key raises the rate limits.

auth.notes: The docs list x-api-key on real-time endpoints, but the example request succeeded without any key; a free key from signup raises limits.

rate_limit.summary: Per 10-second window: real-time APIs 6 requests without a key (12 dev key, 30 prod key); datastore search 4 (8, 20); dataset downloads 2 (4, 10). 429 when exceeded.

endpoints.summary: Air temperature readings per weather station

agent_notes: The rate limit is small without a key (6 real-time calls per 10 seconds), so cache. Real-time endpoints take an optional date parameter and paginate with paginationToken. For tables, take the d_... dataset id from the dataset page URL and pass it as resource_id to datastore_search on the data.gov.sg host (a different host from the real-time API). Timestamps carry the +08:00 offset.
caveats: Three hosts are involved: api-open.data.gov.sg (real-time), data.gov.sg (datastore_search) and api-production.data.gov.sg (collections metadata).
Rate limit enforcement was announced to start on 31 December 2025; the docs mark keys as required on real-time endpoints but keyless calls worked today.
The licence page returned no text to curl; the licence name is taken from the docs and not re-confirmed.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; datastore_search and the collections endpoint also returned 200 without a key.
